state.task: Advice on precise remaining implementation choices before explicitly authorized Muse implementation; do not reinterpret human requirements or treat prior advice as authority.
fixed_requirements: Given has named and inline model/field traits, plus named custom keywords defining new standalone Given declarations with targets/arguments and genuinely new implicit semantics; no inline keyword prompts. Builtin policy/unique/invariant/lock remain native, not prompt replacement targets.

Every generation definition has static $"...". When do bodies stay ordinary Can. Then named styles are reusable and all rendered components may carry inline style prompts or named references; frontend is default.
Manual retry regenerates ALL active-app closure prompts freshly, including preferred successful output, without authored selectors. Ordinary builds use saved edited code and no coding AI.

Coding CLI/model recipe selection remains shared + optional complete profiles. Codex/Muse/Claude/OpenCode native adapters must support custom MCP and enforce no protected source/current/candidate writes; host places all submitted output.

Saved current units under can.generated/<opaque-id>/; isolated candidates and lifecycle under .can/gen/. No second authored registry. Canonical permissions/exact values/admission/atomicity/replay and checked source-owned contributions are required.
Three parallel implementation lanes maximum; interfaces must be frozen before Muse begins code. These are all proposals evaluated fairly at draft stage.

verified_evidence.source: compiler/src/syntax/parser.rs Given dispatch is closed; NAME {...} is model-shaped; custom keyword carriers unimplemented.
verified_evidence.runtime: Generated run/default/check roles alone cannot express all required new keyword integration. Owners have schema/artifact-controlled canonical effect and claim producers; no raw store/context/commit access is allowed.

Current DESIGN.md builtin text operations lack normalization; models.ts:602-611 uniqueness requires stored selectors. pipeline.ts:1909-1917 already nets old/final releases and claims in one commit. New typed pure computed-key producer can join that owner rather than raw generator claims.
verified_evidence.rejected_fixture: Once-per-final-transaction balance invariants are already native; do not count that as new behavior.
verified_evidence.orchestration: Old plan was unit-centered. Human asks entire Then coherent generation; one whole-Then frontend job is recommended, not yet adopted. One CLI may use many internal model calls.
verified_evidence.profiles: Different effective complete recipes can exist in one active app; ordinary saved reuse has no provider dependency.

criteria.whole_then_by_recipe: One frontend coding job per effective compatible recipe receives all app Then content, all prompts/named uses/template/theme/root/part contracts, and submits coherent CSS/view outputs through MCP. Given preparation needed by Then runs before frontend; differing explicit profiles may require multiple jobs with all context.
criteria.single_whole_app: One coding agent job handles all Given and Then outputs together with all context and MCP targets. Simple single run, but different selected recipes/profiles need explicit reconciliation and cannot be silently ignored.
criteria.per_unit_context: One coding job per logical source prompt with full shared context and MCP output. Straightforward unit isolation/profile control, but duplicates context and does not guarantee a jointly coherent result; retry still visits every prompt.
criteria.open: None resolves context/coherence/profile selection and required outputs completely at this stage.

criteria.one_run_journal: Collect and validate the complete full-retry output set; one coordinated run journal covers old/new groups and source/current/fence checks. Accept all or preserve all current output on failure/conflict; atomic per-file writes remain read-gated, recovery restores whole old set before commit or finishes new set after commit.
criteria.independent_groups: Regenerate all prompts, but validate/promote independent unit groups as each succeeds. Smaller journals and useful partial results, yet a frontend coherent job needs its output set grouped consistently and mixed old/new contracts may stop builds.
criteria.open: Neither proposal yields concrete preserved-work, coherent-output and crash-recovery behavior under full retry.

Existing schema activation validates all installed rows/collisions before installing changed key behavior and claims. No authored version registry or raw generated claims.
criteria.explicit_semantic_version: Require author to version each computed-key keyword binding; migration identity follows that explicit value with installed-row validation and canonical claims. Clear intent but additional version bookkeeping may miss direct JS changes.
